commonContract: May engage every eligible close-range terminal threat authorized by the PDS family rules, including missile flights and boarding craft.
Uses established terminal-defense timing and reaction accounting.
Sub-family identity does not silently alter target eligibility.
notes: Checkpoint 51 tactical accuracy and Reaction Capacity values are preserved for the primary Checkpoint 52 combat matrix.
AMM already uses 1 Tactical Power of readiness at both TL1 and TL2, matching Kinetic PDS readiness cost; Energy PDS remains 2 TP.
AMM ammunition is evaluated as campaign/endurance capacity rather than forced to deplete in one duel.

profiles.note: Baseline gun CIWS: cheapest readiness and deep ammunition, lowest candidate accuracy.
Early directed-energy defense: no conventional ammunition, higher readiness power, modest accuracy.
Early interceptor battery: best candidate accuracy, scarce ammunition, still deliberately modest.
Accuracy and ammunition efficiency improve; Reaction Capacity remains one.
Accuracy improves while high readiness power remains the principal tradeoff.
Seeker/reliability and ammunition improve; Reaction Capacity remains one.

ammunitionSensitivityCandidates.policy: Do not lower accuracy merely to make ammunition matter in one fight. Evaluate multiple-encounter endurance first; revisit accuracy only if tactical evidence independently warrants it.
